pages.title: Proton Decay
pages.text: $(thing)Proton Decay$()$(br2)Grand unified theories join quarks and leptons, so even a proton can change into a positron and a pion. Its lifetime is at least 10^34 years - and after the last star, the degenerate era ends when every proton is gone. Unlocks Proton Decay Residue.
$(thing)Insight$(): 180$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Eschatology, Grand Unification.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Superpartner Shard.
